result.summary: Found 2 visible layout issues involving clipped horizontal content and content obscured by the fixed bottom navigation.

issues.description: The “Fastest near you” carousel overflows the right edge, abruptly clipping the third restaurant card, its name, and delivery fee.
issues.suggestion: Constrain the carousel to the viewport and use consistent side padding or intentional card peeking; ensure text is clipped within the card with an ellipsis rather than at the screen boundary.

issues.description: The fixed bottom navigation overlays the second “Popular right now” card, hiding a substantial portion of its image and potentially its details while scrolling.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom padding to the scrollable content equal to the navigation bar and safe-area height so all cards can scroll fully above the overlay.
